ai-cost-cutter v1.0.4

- Significant file restructuring: 4 files added (including AGENTS.md and icons), 4 removed (including LICENSE.md, manifest.json).
- Documentation overhaul: README.md and SKILL.md rewritten for clarity and brevity; major updates to versioning, input/output schemas, use cases, and license clarification.
- "read_when" section and English/Chinese usage instructions improved for easier onboarding.
- Skill metadata standardized, safer permission defaults set; license and attributions clarified and separated per file type.

AI Cost Cutter 1.2.0 introduces practical cost-saving strategies for AI batch processing.

- Provides workflows for reducing API costs via batch processing, local model fallback, caching, and model routing.
- Includes a cost estimation script: input workload and model prices to compare monthly bills and savings from different strategies.
- Aims to help users shift expensive model use to cheaper/local alternatives when possible.
- Outlines clear usage scenarios, boundaries, and anti-patterns to prevent common cost pitfalls.
- Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms, with installation and integration guidance for several AI agent frameworks.
